source.title: Hotel shift handover
source.author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
source.article: The evening receptionist will hand over the booking records to the night team before leaving. Staff must follow up on guest requests that were not resolved during the day. A guest who needs an early taxi should receive a clear confirmation before the morning shift begins. The shared checklist shows who is responsible for each request, so guests do not need to explain the same problem again.
